author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Ninety-Two! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Perfect for new hobbyists and those with some whimsy, this week we're covering something short and sweet. Sometimes models just BEG for a game and PLANET SHARK is one of them. Do you love Gorka Morka? What if it was SHARKS though? Its ALWAYS SHARK WEEK HERE.  Let's check it out!

Check out the the game rules for pay-what-you-want HERE: https://moonlessworks.itch.io/planet-shark

Late backers can still get on the two crowdfunds HERE: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/taigaminiatures/planet-shark
